title: prospect
tagline: Support your favorite creators by streaming a constant subscription fee and get rewarded with loyalty tokens that can be staked to earn you a share of the creators revenue or used to buy exclusive NFTs or products. The earlier you discover and support, the better.
description: This project leverages Superfluid to allow fans to support their favorite creators in a way like never before. By sending a stream of income to creators, you can allow them a new level freedom to create without worrying about the next paycheck. As a thank you for your support, all users subscribed to a creator will receive a loyalty token sent back to them. This loyalty token can be staked with the creators smart contract to enable you to earn a share of their revenue stream. Otherwise these tokens can be used to buy exclusive NFTs & merch from creators, allowing them to retain a higher percentage of their revenue.  With this system it pays to be early. The loyalty tokens have a constant distribution so you get more tokens the earlier you are.
how_its_made: This project is mainly built around Superfluid's awesome payment streams and subgraphs (The Graph). The smart-contracts are written in solidity and are deployed to Polygon. The front end is written with Next.js and uses Web3.js to interact with the blockchain. Users can connect with Metamask or WalletConnect.
